description:
Question: With more light, does canopy area grow faster? 提高光照后，冠层增长是否加快？
Hypothesis: 70 % 光照下冠层面积日增长高于 40 %。
name: diagri-snap_0004

prov:wasDerivedFrom.description: DiAGRI snapshot; sha256 is the digest of its manifest.json.
